agent: mapdraw follow-up, the near map's province names
question: The near map's province names, exactly: who shows an entry, the slots' lifecycle and the fade's clock, the layout (wrap, origin, rotation, scale, height, matrix, vertices), the text, the draw and its gates, and positions.txt's defaults.

addresses.name: ProvinceTexts_Create
addresses.comment: **The near map's province names**, built once as the map is made (the 'CreateProvinceTexts()' step, called at rva 0x454084, then ProvinceTexts_CreateBuffers at 0x45408A): for every map tile (WaterObject +0x19C, 0x3C0 a tile, +0x18C x +0x190 of them) and every province graphics entry in the tile's vector (tile +0; each province is in exactly one tile, FINDINGS-mapdraw.md A.1), one 0x60-byte ProvinceMapText pushed on the tile's deque (MapTile +0x120, count +0x130), copied from a stack template by 0x46D7D0: the template's name (CProvinceTemplate_GetName, +0xB0 - the localisation of PROV<id>, CProvinceTemplate_LocaliseName), the province id (the CMapProvince's +0xD0), **shown = 1 for every entry, land and sea**, is_sea = template +0x22 clear, slot -1, x = text_position x (+0x3C) - the tile's middle x, **y = 0.52** (the float at VA 0x160A438), z = text_position y (+0x40) - the tile's middle z, rotation = text_rotation (+0x54), scale = text_scale (+0x58). The tile's middle is width x column + width/2 and height x row + height/2 (tile size +0x194/+0x198, 50), i.e. the tile's own translation, so with the tile's world matrix the name lands on text_position itself. **No test of anything**: a province with no text_position gets the template's default (0, 0) and its name is laid out at the map's south-west corner; is_sea is read by nothing but the copy. `ret 4` at 0x456A0B. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-farmap.md, section B.7.
addresses.revises: Adds the entry's layout (the stack template at [ebp-0x94]: shown byte written 1, y 0.52, the tile-middle formula), that the shown byte is set for every entry and the sea byte is never read, and where the name comes from. Name and signature unchanged.

Wrong if 0x86D7D0 does not copy +0x44 (it does, 0x86D83E-0x86D841).

addresses.name: ProvinceTexts_CreateBuffers
addresses.comment: Clears the 1000 slots at WaterObject +0x2D8 (ProvinceTextSlot, 0x10 a slot: used byte, alpha, start time, text) - used 0, start 0, text null - and gives every province text (each tile's +0x120 deque) a dynamic 300-vertex buffer in its own MeshBuffer (ProvinceMapText +0): VertexBuffer_Create(text, device, 300, 0x14, 0x102 = XYZ|TEX1, dynamic). 300 vertices are 50 letters, which is why ProvinceTexts_Update cuts a name longer than 50 to 49. Callers (rvas): the map build (0x45408A, after ProvinceTexts_Create) and the renderer's device-reset handler (0x46829D), which the lost-device handler's ProvinceTexts_ReleaseBuffers (0x468274) pairs - so a device reset frees every slot and every name fades in again. `ret 4`.
addresses.revises: Says what the slot clear writes, that the buffer goes into the text's own MeshBuffer, and that the second caller is the device-reset handler paired with ProvinceTexts_ReleaseBuffers. Name and signature unchanged.

Callers by findRefs: 0x85408A, 0x86829D; ReleaseBuffers called at 0x868274 in the same handler pair. Wrong if 0x86829D is not on the reset path.

addresses.name: ProvinceTexts_Update
addresses.comment: **Fades the province names in and lays out the ones that have just been given a slot.** Called only from MapGraphics_Update (0x45D6F1), where the camera height is strictly below 100.0 (the double at VA 0x160A358, compared at 0x45D6D9). (1) now = the renderer's clock (WaterObject +0x28, slot 5, CHighPerfWinClock::GetSeconds - seconds, as a float); for each of the 1000 slots (+0x2D8) that is used and has alpha below 255: alpha = trunc((now - start) x 170.0), capped at 255 - **so a name takes 1.5 s to reach full strength**. (2) For each visible tile (+0x78 deque, count +0x88) in that order, and each of its texts (MapTile +0x120, count +0x130) in deque order: where the text has no slot (+0x48 < 0) and is shown (+0x44, which nothing ever clears), the first free slot of the 1000 is taken - **none free: the function returns there**, the rest waiting for a later frame - with used 1, alpha 0 (or **255 where WaterObject +0x4288 is set**, which is then cleared), start = the clock read again, text = the entry, and the text's slot index written. Then its buffer is locked (DISCARD where the MeshBuffer is dynamic and +0x16 clear), all 6000 bytes zeroed (so unused vertices are degenerate), the name (+0x24) copied and, **longer than 50 characters, cut to its first 49**, and laid out by BitmapFont_LayOutTextQuads(the tahoma_60 font +0x4178, buffer, name, origin = (+0x4C, +0x50, +0x54), up = (-sin r, 0, cos r), along = (cos r, 0, sin r), scale = text_scale (+0x5C) x 0.5, maxWidth 320) with r = text_rotation (+0x58) through FloatCos and FloatSin - radians; along x up is the world's up, so a positive r turns the name anticlockwise as the map is seen, east right and north up - then unlocked. **No upper-casing** (the country names' CharUpperBuffA is in CountryMapName_Build, not here), no read of the sea byte (+0x45) or of the font's colour; the layout's vertex count is not kept (the draw draws all 300). `ret 4` at 0x456490, and the early `ret 4` at 0x456061.
addresses.revises: Read whole: the clock is seconds (slot 5 GetSeconds) so the fade is 1.5 s; the slot-taking returns when none is free; the up and along vectors are (-sin, 0, cos) and (cos, 0, sin) of text_rotation through cosf/sinf; origin is the entry's +0x4C..+0x54; no upper-casing. Confidence inferred -> confirmed. Name and signature unchanged.

Wrong if 0xC0BCC0 were sin (its x87 path holds fcos at 0xC0BD2D).

addresses.name: ProvinceTexts_Draw
addresses.comment: **Draws the province names.** MapGraphics_DrawScene calls it (rva 0x45C411) only below camera height 100 (its near byte) and where layer-mask bit 0x8 ((GameSettings +0xF0) & (+0xEC)) is set - which is every map mode (all six masks the setters write, 0xFF9A, 0xFFAA, 0xFFBA, 0xFFBB, 0xFFBE, 0xFFFF, have it) and every setting (+0xEC starts 0xFFFF and only bit 0 is ever changed, by CSettingsScreen::StoreChoices). Device states, set once: sampler 0 MIN and MAG LINEAR (mip filter not set), LIGHTING 0, ALPHABLENDENABLE 1, SRCBLEND SRCALPHA, DESTBLEND INVSRCALPHA, ZWRITEENABLE 0, ZENABLE 0; stage 0 COLOROP and ALPHAOP MODULATE of TEXTURE and TFACTOR, stage 1 COLOROP and ALPHAOP DISABLE; texture 0 = the tahoma_60 font's atlas (the texture table +0x15C, 0x2C a slot, by the font's +0x49C; none where -1 or above 9999). CULLMODE is not set. Then for each visible tile (+0x78, count +0x88) in order and each of its texts in deque order: where shown (+0x44), with a slot (+0x48 >= 0) and that slot's alpha not 0: WORLD = the tile's world matrix (+0x17C, the tile's middle less the camera's settled x and y, shifted a map's width across the seam), TEXTUREFACTOR saved, set to alpha << 24 | 0xFFFFFF, VertexBuffer_Draw of the text's mesh (a 300-vertex TRIANGLELIST, 100 triangles, the unused ones degenerate), TEXTUREFACTOR put back. **Colour: the atlas's own (kart_font's is black) times 1; alpha the atlas's times alpha/255.** At the end only stage 0's COLORARG2 and ALPHAARG2 (CURRENT) and ALPHAOP (MODULATE) are put back. Bare `ret` at 0x460D20.
addresses.revises: The device states listed one by one, the alpha-0 skip, the order, that CULLMODE is not set, what is restored at the end, and that mask bit 0x8 is set in every mode and by every setting. Name and signature unchanged.

Masks: every immediate written to settings +0xF0 (FINDINGS-mapdraw.md) has 0x8; +0xEC: constructor 0x45FAFA writes 0xFFFF, StoreChoices 0x6F80CE/0x6F80EA bit 0 only (scan of 0x45F000-0x462000 and 0x6F7000-0x6FA000).

addresses.name: BitmapFont_LayOutTextQuads
addresses.signature: int __stdcall BitmapFont_LayOutTextQuads(CEU3BitmapFont* font, void* vertices, Hoi3CString* text, float* origin, float* up, float* along, float scale, int maxWidth)
addresses.comment: **Writes a text's glyphs as flat quads in 3D**, six 20-byte vertices (x y z u v) to a glyph, and answers the number of vertices written; nothing for an empty text. **Two passes.** (1) Measure and break, char by char of the input: a char with no glyph (the font's +0x94 table, by the raw byte) ends the line where it is a newline or carriage return and is otherwise skipped; a glyph adds its xadvance (+0x18) and its kerning with the next char (+0x81C pairs at +0x1C) to the line and to the current word; **a glyph of height (+0xC) 0 - the space - ends the word, and only there is the line tested: where the line, this word and its space included, is wider than maxWidth (strictly), a line break goes in before the word**, which starts the new line; the previous line's width keeps its trailing space. So the last word is never tested, a word is never split, and a first word that is itself too wide leaves an empty first line. At most 55 lines. (2) Lay out: top = lines x the font's lineHeight (+0x494); each line's pen starts at -trunc(its width / 2), so each line is centred on the origin, and each line break lowers top by lineHeight - **the block stands on the origin, its bottom at 0 and its top at lines x lineHeight**, not centred vertically. A glyph of height under 1 only advances the pen (xadvance, no kerning); any other gets a quad from x = pen + xoffset (+0x10) to that + width (+8), y = top - yoffset (+0x14) - height to top - yoffset, u, v = its pixel rectangle (+0, +4) over the atlas size (+0x4A0, +0x4A4), v0 at the glyph's top; world = origin + along x (x x 0.05 x scale) + up x (y x 0.05 x scale). Vertices in the order (x0,y0) (x1,y0) (x0,y1), (x1,y1) (x1,y0) (x0,y1), y0 the bottom. Never reads the font's colour (+0x38). Callers (rvas): CountryMapName_Build, ProvinceTexts_Update (0x4563FC) and the battle-plan arrow texts (0x663D13).
addresses.revises: Read whole: where and how lines break (only at a height-0 glyph, before the word whose trailing space passes maxWidth, the last word never tested, an empty first line possible), the vertical anchor (bottom of the block on the origin), the vertex order and the return value. Confidence inferred -> confirmed. Name and signature unchanged.
addresses.evidence: disasm 0xAFF5E0-0xB00156. Pass 1: 0xAFF6A0-0xAFF846; no glyph 0xAFF92B-0xAFF9A0 (0x0A, 0x0D); advance 0xAFF741-0xAFF79B; height test 0xAFF7A1 `cmp [edx+0xC],0`; 0xAFF7AE `cmp esi,[ebp+0x24]; jle`; break: append '\n' (VA 0x15B57D0) then the word, line width = esi - word (0xAFF7E7), esi = word; cap 0x37 at 0xAFF7F4. Pass 2: top = (lines) x [font+0x494] at 0xAFF86F; pen = -(w0/2) at 0xAFF880; newline 0xAFF908-0xAFF926; quad 0xAFF9A5-0xB0008B with 0.05 (VA 0x160A510); blank 0xAFF9BB; count +6 at 0xAFFFA8; return [ebp-0x18] at 0xB00146. Wrong if [edx+0xC] were not the glyph height (kart_font.fnt gives height 0 to the space, and also to 215 and 247, which therefore break words too).

addresses.name: MapGraphics_RefreshByFlags
addresses.signature: void __stdcall MapGraphics_RefreshByFlags(WaterObject* mgr@EDI, uint32_t flags@stack:4, void* changedProvinces@stack:8)
addresses.comment: **The map renderer's refresh by flags**, called by CInGameIdler_RefreshMap (0x25190E, with the idler's +0x84 and +0x88) and CFrontEnd::Update (0x2EE102). 0x460D30 to the `ret 8` at 0x461472, a cold block after it. Builds a deque of dirty rectangles (DequeRect_PushBack): the whole map inside a one-pixel margin when the changed-province list is empty, holds -1 or has more than 100 entries, else each province's bounding box (template +0x80..+0x8C) padded by 2. **Flags bit 0**: BorderManager_UpdateControllerBits(flags, borders), BorderManager_ApplyDiagonalCuts, BorderManager_SpreadCornerBits, then ViewsTextureManager_UpdateBorderLookup - over every corner entry, not only the rectangles. Bit 2, where +0x42E8 is set: the tree slots (+0x134) of tiles meeting the rectangle are freed, or all of them and MapObjects_RebuildTileStrips. Then, with the map's player id (CMap +0x2A8C) read: bit 1 and no player (id 0) - stop; bit 1 - each province entry's template +0xA8 = Province_IsHiddenByFog; then, where the player id is not 0, **the shown byte (+0x44) of every province text (each tile's MapTile +0x120 deque) = 1** - which is what ProvinceTexts_Create already wrote, and nothing writes 0, so it changes nothing. Province_SetController sets bit 0 of the idler's flags (VA 0x4A3585) when the controller really changed, and pushes the province id onto +0x88 (-1 past 110 entries). Only the border block was read closely. The name is ours. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-mapdraw.md, section B.7.
addresses.revises: The +0x120 list is the province texts and +0x44 their shown byte; CMap +0x2A8C is the player's country id; with bit 1 set and no player the function stops before the shown-byte loop. Name and signature unchanged.

addresses.name: MapGraphics_Update
addresses.signature: void __stdcall MapGraphics_Update(void* graphics, MapCamera* camera, void* unknown, bool force)
addresses.comment: **The map's pictures and layers brought up to date, each frame** - called by the graphics owner's update (rva 0x241D00, with graphics owner +0x1DC4 and its +0x60DC) and at 0x29EB69. `ret 0x10` at 0x45D950, with a cold block past it reached from 0x45C7F1 (trap 3); the `ret 4` at 0x45DB1C was not attributed. Read in part: under height 100 (VA 0x160A358) it rebuilds the tile strips (0x462260, 0x455EA0); keeps the height at +0x4174; **far = camera height strictly above counter_distance (settings +0xFC)** at 0x45D7B2, handed to ProvinceGraphics_Update for every province graphics entry from 1 - which is where each unit's avatar is told it is seen from far; then MapObjects_UpdateLayerVisibility. The third argument's slot is reused as a local. **In the per-tile visibility pass** (MapTile +0x138, remade as the camera moves): where a tile's visible byte has just gone from 1 to 0 and the camera's height is below its highest_height (+0x350, 1000) less 30, every province text of the tile (+0x120) that holds a slot gives it up (slot used byte 0, text's slot -1) - **this is how a name loses its slot, so a tile that comes back into view fades its names in again** (0x45CF93..0x45D0EA). The rva 0x45CA30 the record names MapTile_Update is an instruction inside this pass's loop (0x45CA28..0x45CA4A, the template +0x13D test), not an entry. The name is ours. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-farmap.md, sections A and B.7.

addresses.name: ProvinceTexts_ReleaseBuffers
addresses.comment: The lost-device half of ProvinceTexts_CreateBuffers: every one of the 1000 slots (+0x2D8) freed (used 0, text null); for every province text of every tile, Release (COM slot 2) its mesh's vertex buffer (+0), index buffer (+4) and declaration (+8) where set, zero +0, +4, +8, +0xC, +0x10 and +0x1C, and its slot = -1. One caller, the renderer's lost-device handler (call at VA 0x868274, beside MapTrees_ReleaseSlotBuffers at 0x868283); the reset handler then calls ProvinceTexts_CreateBuffers (0x86829D). So after a lost device every name has to take a slot again and fades in from nothing. `ret 4` at 0x4565FF. The name is ours.

addresses.name: ProvinceTexts_Refresh
addresses.signature: void __stdcall ProvinceTexts_Refresh(WaterObject* manager, int provinceId, CMapPoint* position, float rotation, float scale)
addresses.comment: **Re-places one province's name and frees its slot so it is laid out again.** Sets WaterObject +0x4288 = 1 (so the next slot taken comes up at alpha 255, no fade); for every province text of every tile whose province id (+0x40) is provinceId: frees its slot where it has one (used byte 0) and sets its slot to -1; x, z = position's x and y (+8, +0xC) less the tile's middle; **y = 0.0 where the province under (trunc x, trunc y) in the province raster (CMap +0x20E0) is sea (template +0x22 clear), else 0.02** (the float at VA 0x17179B0, also where no province is found) - where ProvinceTexts_Create had put 0.52; rotation (+0x58) and scale (+0x5C) as given. The callers all pass the template's own text_position point (+0x34), text_rotation (+0x54) and text_scale (+0x58): CRenameProvinceEffect::Execute (0x5B0A46) and CChangeProvinceNameCommand::Execute (0x14DE18), each after ProvinceTexts_SetText, and eight more from 0x241DE0 and seven functions in 0x29ED40..0x2A06BF that no table holds - the one read (0x29ED40) adds 0.1 to a template's text_scale while it is below 3.0 and then calls this, so they are by all appearance the hidden map editor's (*inferred*). `ret 0x14` at 0x455E9C. The name is ours.

The name is ours.

addresses.name: CChangeProvinceNameCommand::Execute
addresses.comment: `CChangeProvinceNameCommand` slot 6, one holder (vftable VA 0x15C3BE4). Renames a province: the province (state's province array +0xB8C, index +0x58) slot 7 (SetName) with the name (+0x3C); then, through the in-game screen's map object (state +0xBE8, slot 15, +0x1DC4), ProvinceTexts_SetText(province id, the name) and ProvinceTexts_Refresh(province id, the template's text_position point (+0x34), text_rotation (+0x54), text_scale (+0x58)) - so the new name is laid out again, at y 0.02 or 0.0 rather than 0.52, and comes up at once rather than fading. Bare `ret` at 0x14DF10. Who posts the command was not looked for.
addresses.evidence: vtable.py CChangeProvinceNameCommand --all: slot 6 = 0x54DBF0, one table. disasm 0x54DBF0-0x54DF10: 0x54DC88-0x54DC9D [state+0xB8C][this+0x58] slot +0x1C with this+0x3C; 0x54DD5D call 0x868400; 0x54DE18 call 0x855BA0 with template+0x34, +0x54, +0x58; ret at 0x54DF10.

addresses.name: FloatCos
addresses.comment: cosf: the CRT's _CIcos (VA 0xC0BCC0, its x87 path an fcos) on the float, answered as a float. The province names' along vector is (cos, 0, sin) of text_rotation through it and FloatSin. Bare `ret`. The name is ours.
addresses.evidence: disasm 0x588870-0x58888C: fld [ebp+8]; call 0xC0BCC0; fstp/fld; ret. 0xC0BCC0's fallback 0xC0BD18 holds fcos at 0xC0BD2D and 0xC0BD64. Called at 0x856202 by ProvinceTexts_Update.

addresses.name: FloatSin
addresses.comment: sinf: the CRT's _CIsin (VA 0xC0BB90, its x87 path an fsin) on the float, answered as a float. Bare `ret`. The name is ours.
addresses.evidence: disasm 0x588890-0x5888AC: fld [ebp+8]; call 0xC0BB90; fstp/fld; ret. 0xC0BB90's fallback 0xC0BBE8 holds fsin at 0xC0BBFD and 0xC0BC34. Called at 0x856214 by ProvinceTexts_Update.

structs.name: ProvinceMapText
structs.comment: One province's name on the near map, made by ProvinceTexts_Create - one per province, on its tile's deque (MapTile +0x120). No vftable, no RTTI. The name is ours. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-farmap.md, section B.7.
structs.evidence: `new` of 0x60 bytes at 0x856922, filled by the copy 0x86D7D0, which copies +0 to +0x5C and nothing past it (0x86D7E8-0x86D866).

structs.name: ProvinceTextSlot
structs.comment: One of the 1000 slots at WaterObject +0x2D8 that a province name must hold to be laid out and drawn. The name is ours. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-farmap.md, section B.7.
structs.evidence: stride 0x10 in every loop over them (0x855F29, 0x856046, 0x856641, 0x8564BC) and the index scaling `add eax, eax` then `*8` (0x855C7F, 0x860BB3, 0x85D08C).

struct_fields.name: mesh
struct_fields.comment: Its 300-vertex dynamic buffer (XYZ|TEX1, stride 0x14), made by ProvinceTexts_CreateBuffers and drawn whole by VertexBuffer_Draw.
struct_fields.evidence: 0x8566D2 the element passed as VertexBuffer_Create's mesh; 0x860C95 passed in EAX to VertexBuffer_Draw; 0x856437 [text]+0 slot +0x30 Unlock.

struct_fields.name: text
struct_fields.comment: The name drawn: the template's name (PROV<id> localised) at creation, replaced by ProvinceTexts_SetText.
struct_fields.evidence: 0x8567E2 assign into [ebp-0x70] (template +0x24); 0x85636C read by ProvinceTexts_Update; 0x86850D written by ProvinceTexts_SetText.

struct_fields.name: province_id
struct_fields.comment: The province's id (its CMapProvince's +0xD0); what ProvinceTexts_SetText and ProvinceTexts_Refresh match.
struct_fields.evidence: 0x856816 [ebp-0x54]; 0x855C34 and 0x868491 compared with the id argument.

struct_fields.name: shown
struct_fields.comment: Tested by the update and the draw; written 1 by ProvinceTexts_Create and by MapGraphics_RefreshByFlags (where there is a player), and 0 by nothing found - so every name, land and sea, is a candidate.
struct_fields.evidence: 0x856819 1; 0x861427 1; reads 0x85602C, 0x860B39. A sweep of byte stores to +0x44 in every int3-bounded chunk calling the deque indexer 0x86B620, and of stores of any size at +0x44 in 0x830000-0x880000, found only those two and the copy 0x86D841 - the positive control is that it found both known writers.

struct_fields.name: is_sea
struct_fields.comment: Set where the template's is_land (+0x22) is clear. Read by nothing but the copy.
struct_fields.evidence: 0x856828 sete; a scan of 0x84F000-0x870000 for [reg+0x45] finds only the copy's 0x86D844/0x86D847.

struct_fields.name: slot
struct_fields.comment: Index of the ProvinceTextSlot it holds, or -1.
struct_fields.evidence: 0x8568EE -1 at creation; 0x8560AD written on taking; 0x855CC3, 0x8565C6, 0x85D0D9 -1 on freeing.

struct_fields.name: x
struct_fields.comment: text_position x less its tile's middle x.
struct_fields.evidence: 0x856885 subsd and 0x8568B4; 0x855DD5 (Refresh); read 0x8562A5 as the origin's x.

struct_fields.name: y
struct_fields.comment: World height of the text: 0.52 from ProvinceTexts_Create; 0.02 on land and 0.0 on sea once ProvinceTexts_Refresh has run.
struct_fields.evidence: VA 0x160A438 (0.52) via [ebp-0x2C] at 0x856772; 0x855DD5 movq writes +0x4C/+0x50 with 0.0 or 0.02 (VA 0x17179B0); read 0x85629B.

struct_fields.name: z
struct_fields.comment: text_position y less its tile's middle z.
struct_fields.evidence: 0x8568A2 subsd, 0x8568C1 [ebp-0x40]; 0x855DDA (Refresh); read 0x85627C.

struct_fields.name: rotation
struct_fields.comment: text_rotation in radians; along = (cos, 0, sin), up = (-sin, 0, cos).
struct_fields.evidence: 0x8568CC template +0x54; 0x855E20 (Refresh); read 0x85619E into FloatCos/FloatSin.

struct_fields.name: scale
struct_fields.comment: text_scale; the layout's scale is this x 0.5.
struct_fields.evidence: 0x8568DE template +0x58; 0x855E57 (Refresh); read 0x8561DE, x 0.5 (VA 0x160A308).

struct_fields.name: used
struct_fields.comment: Held by a text. Set by ProvinceTexts_Update; cleared by ProvinceTexts_CreateBuffers, ProvinceTexts_ReleaseBuffers, ProvinceTexts_Refresh and MapGraphics_Update when the text's tile stops being visible.
struct_fields.evidence: 0x8560B0 1; 0x856630, 0x8564B7, 0x855C81, 0x85D08E 0. A sweep of all .text (2,755,661 instructions, int3-bounded chunks) for +0x2D8..+0x2E4 and +0x4288 found no other store in the renderer.

struct_fields.name: alpha
struct_fields.comment: 0 to 255: min(255, trunc((now - start) x 170)), now in seconds; 255 at once after ProvinceTexts_Refresh. 0 is not drawn.

struct_fields.name: start_seconds
struct_fields.comment: The renderer's clock (CHighPerfWinClock::GetSeconds) when the slot was taken.
struct_fields.evidence: 0x8560F3 `fstp [esi + (slot+0x2E)*16]`; read 0x855EFE.

struct_fields.name: text
struct_fields.comment: The holder. Written and cleared; nothing reads it.
struct_fields.evidence: 0x85612F written; 0x856634 and 0x8564BA cleared; the .text sweep finds no read through the slot array.

struct_fields.name: province_text_slots
struct_fields.comment: The 1000 slots a province name must hold to be laid out and drawn (ProvinceTexts_Update takes them, B.7 of FINDINGS-farmap.md).
struct_fields.evidence: every loop over 0x3E8 entries of 0x10 from +0x2D8/+0x2DC/+0x2E4 (0x855EDE, 0x856040, 0x85661C, 0x8564AA).

struct_fields.name: province_text_instant
struct_fields.comment: Set by ProvinceTexts_Refresh, cleared by the constructor and by the next slot ProvinceTexts_Update takes, which comes up at alpha 255 instead of fading in - whichever text that is.
struct_fields.evidence: 0x84F80B 0; 0x855BC1 1; 0x8560C1 test, 0x8560D7 0. The whole-.text sweep finds no other access.

struct_fields.name: province_texts
struct_fields.comment: Start of a std::deque of ProvinceMapText* - the names of the provinces in the tile, in the order of the tile's province vector (+0); 0x86B620 indexes it. Count at +0x130.
struct_fields.evidence: ProvinceTexts_Create 0x8568E3 `add esi, 0x120`, push-back via [esi+4], [esi+8], [esi+0xC], [esi+0x10]; every reader does lea ecx, [tile+0x120] then call 0x86B620.

struct_fields.name: province_text_count
struct_fields.comment: The size of the deque at +0x120.
struct_fields.evidence: 0x856965 `inc [esi+0x10]` with esi = tile+0x120; loop bounds at 0x855F96, 0x860AE7, 0x8613DB.

struct_fields.name: layer_mask_ec
struct_fields.comment: ANDed with +0xF0 by the renderer. 0xFFFF from the constructor; only bit 0 is ever changed, set or cleared with renderTrees by CSettingsScreen::StoreChoices. So the other bits, the province names' 0x8 among them, follow the map mode's +0xF0 alone.
struct_fields.revises: Comment only: its default and that only bit 0 is ever written. Name and type unchanged.
struct_fields.evidence: 0x45FAC8 mov eax, 0xFFFF and 0x45FAFA `mov [edi+0xEC], eax` in the settings constructor (0x45FA80); 0x6F80CE and 0x6F80EA in StoreChoices. A scan of 0x45F000-0x462000 and 0x6F7000-0x6FA000 for dword stores at +0xEC found those three; the 854 +0xEC stores elsewhere in .text were not each tied to the settings object.
